style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, heavy painted gouache background, deep inky blacks, one coloured light source (ghostly blue-green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text.

pictures.ep_old_train: Fog and darkness on a disused halt at the Midnight Hour, a single blue-green headlamp growing out of the white, a lone fiddle somewhere in the dark
pictures.ep_old_train_2: A black locomotive screeching to a halt on rails of pale mist, sparks of green light, a moonlit station sign half-eaten by fog
pictures.ep_old_train_3: A train door creaking open in the fog, a mottled-green frogman in a patched coat and a hat with three railroad spikes hopping down to the platform with a sprig of wheat in his mouth
pictures.ep_last_ride: Seen through a train window, the Hollow shrinking in the dark and the Crooked Moon sneering down, its grin now a scowl
pictures.ep_last_ride_2: Only fog rushing past a train window, pale and silver, with a faint blue-green reflection of a lamp on the glass
